caveats: Rates secondary (grade S): 13% standard plus tiered reduced rates from VATCalc's 2026 table; hacienda.go.cr blocked or scripted its rate pages this session.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

The 13% standard rate dates from the entry into force of Law 9635 on 1 July 2019; the transitional tourism rates that law phased in (4%, 8%) are not modelled as separate rows. The transitional (temporary) rates are outside this dataset's rate bands.

Lower-bound rows - reduced (2022-01-01), reduced2 (2022-01-01), reduced3 (2022-01-01), reduced4 (2022-01-01), zero (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (the OECD's reduced-rate data first confirms the band on 1 January 2024; it is assumed to predate 2022 but the true start is unsourced).
